title: Automotive ERP System
description: Transformed fragmented workshop operations into a scalable multi-tenant SaaS architecture MVP.
summary: Sol Garage is an end-to-end multi-tenant automotive ERP that brings jobs, staff, and billing into one streamlined system. I scoped the MVP from on-ground operator interviews and locked requirements with interactive wireframes. A strict tenant permission hierarchy keeps every garage's data fully isolated.
outcome: 30% less scope creep, zero privilege-escalation flaws
highlights: Scoped the MVP from on-ground operator interviews
Designed multi-tenant architecture with strict permission hierarchy
Locked requirements early with interactive functional wireframes
